propositions: LLMConfig must expose a headers field (dict[str, str]) to allow operators behind gateways to label outbound requests without silent credential displacement.

Headers resolve from three layers (CLI -c llm.headers > REBAR_LLM_HEADERS env var > [tool.rebar.llm] file table) with precedence order enforced and malformed JSON raising LLMConfigError (never degrading to {}).

A grammar with two namespaces (${env:VAR} resolved at config time with unset vars as hard error, ${run:KEY} left unresolved with KEY validated against closed vocabulary {trace_id, ticket_id, operation}) prevents typos and unrecognized placeholders from silently passing through.
Validation runs post-substitution on resolved values to catch control-character injection via environment indirection (e.g., VAR=foo\r\nInjected: bar blocks after substitution, not before).

Denied header names (authorization, x-api-key, cookie, host, proxy-authorization case-insensitive) and invalid characters (non-RFC 7230 token names, CR/LF/NUL in values) each raise LLMConfigError with error message redirecting to llm.api_key as the supported alternative channel.
$$ escapes to a literal $ anywhere (e.g., $${VAR} yields ${VAR}, a$$b yields a$b) following OpenTelemetry Collector convention.
